data.value: Discover the story behind Bagheera's Dream, our passion for British Shorthair cats and the values that guide our cattery.

data.name: HeroDescription
data.value: More than a cattery. A passion built around beautiful cats, wonderful personalities and the love they bring into our lives.

data.name: StoryDescription
data.value: Twelve years ago, my journey into the wonderful world of British Shorthairs began with just two cats and a heart full of love for the breed. What started as a small passion slowly grew into something much bigger – a family, a lifelong commitment and a home filled with beautiful cats, each with their own personality and place in my heart.

data.name: PhilosophyDescription
data.value: The values that guide everything we do.

data.name: LoveCareDescription
data.value: Every cat deserves affection, attention and a caring environment.

data.name: HealthWellbeingDescription
data.value: The health and wellbeing of our cats always come first.

data.name: ResponsibleBreedingDescription
data.value: We believe in thoughtful decisions and responsible breeding practices.

data.name: HappyFamiliesDescription
data.value: Our wish is for every kitten to find a loving and caring forever home.

data.name: BreedDescription
data.value: Today, our cattery is home to a big family of both breeding and non-breeding cats. For me, every cat matters, regardless of whether they are part of the breeding programme or simply enjoying their well-deserved life as beloved family members.
